title: Deciphering Internal Regulatory Patterns within the p53 Core Tetramer: Insights from Community Network Analysis.
journal: The journal of physical chemistry letters
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子分子动力学模拟和社区网络分析研究p53核心四聚体的动态连接与调控模式，属于蛋白质-DNA互作相关但非直接TF-DNA结合位点预测，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Gene therapy is one of the most effective strategies for cancer treatment. The p53 protein, commonly known as the "guardian of the genome", plays a critical role in gene activation and tumor suppression. Tetramerization of the p53 core domain is an essential allosteric process that supports its suppression functions. This letter presents a framework to analyze the structure, function, and dynamic connectivity of the p53 tetramer, using community network analysis based on all-atom molecular dynamics simulations. The communities within the p53 monomer exhibit distinct functional roles, while interactions between molecules establish a symmetrical network structure. We identified direct evidence of single, double, and multiple pathway regulations within the p53 tetramer and crucial residue pairs involved in these connections. Our study provides a comprehensive framework to understand the community network of the p53 tetramer, offering new insights into the stable formation of the p53 core tetramer.
abstract_zh: 基因治疗是癌症治疗最有效的策略之一。p53蛋白，通常被称为“基因组守护者”，在基因激活和肿瘤抑制中扮演关键角色。p53核心结构域的四聚化是支持其抑制功能的重要变构过程。本文提出一个框架，基于全原子分子动力学模拟，利用社群网络分析来解析p53四聚体的结构、功能和动态连接性。p53单体内部的社群展现出不同的功能角色，而分子间的相互作用则建立了一个对称的网络结构。我们识别了p53四聚体内单重、双重及多重通路调控的直接证据，以及参与这些连接的关键残基对。我们的研究为理解p53四聚体的社群网络提供了一个全面框架，为p53核心四聚体的稳定形成提供了新见解。
